# WordPress admin CSS for screenshots

These files are copied unmodified from WordPress core and are used only by the
static screenshot templates in `../templates/`.

Source: <https://wordpress.org/> (GPLv2 or later).

| File | Origin |
| --- | --- |
| `css/common.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/common.min.css` |
| `css/forms.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/forms.min.css` |
| `css/admin-menu.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/admin-menu.min.css` |
| `css/list-tables.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/list-tables.min.css` |
| `css/edit.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/edit.min.css` |
| `css/buttons.min.css` | `wp-includes/css/buttons.min.css` |
| `css/dashicons.min.css` | `wp-includes/css/dashicons.min.css` |
| `css/admin-bar.min.css` | `wp-includes/css/admin-bar.min.css` |
| `css/colors/modern/colors.min.css` | `wp-admin/css/colors/modern/colors.min.css` |
| `fonts/dashicons.woff2`, `fonts/dashicons.woff` | `wp-includes/fonts/` |
